tasks.label: 📱 Android: Build & Install to Device
tasks.command: cd ottie-mobile; bun run build; bunx cap sync android; cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; cd ..; adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb shell monkey -p com.ottie.vault 1

tasks.label: 📱 Android: Fast Sync Web Code
tasks.command: cd ottie-mobile; bun run build; bunx cap sync android

tasks.label: 📱 Android: Open in Android Studio
tasks.command: cd ottie-mobile; bunx cap open android

tasks.label: 📱 Android: Install Debug APK (ADB)
tasks.command: adb install -r ottie-mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb shell monkey -p com.ottie.vault 1
